Sources.name: Public EVM JSON-RPC receipt
Sources.citation: eth_getTransactionReceipt result object (exact result bytes hashed).
Sources.limitations: Keyless read-only JSON-RPC; shared public endpoint; receipt is reorg-sensitive and briefly cached. SHA-256 covers the JSON-RPC result object; exact HTTP response bytes are separately hashed and retained.

Sources.name: Public EVM JSON-RPC block
Sources.citation: eth_getBlockByHash result object (exact result bytes hashed).
Sources.limitations: Keyless read-only JSON-RPC; block hash was checked against the receipt; recent-chain reorganizations remain possible. Exact result and HTTP response bytes are retained with separate hashes.

Sources.name: Public EVM JSON-RPC transaction
Sources.citation: eth_getTransactionByHash result object (exact result bytes hashed).
Sources.limitations: Keyless read-only JSON-RPC; transaction fields are checked against the confirmed receipt block. Exact result and HTTP response bytes are retained with separate hashes.
